key_points: Regulatory approval secured for the $5 bn Rose carbon‑capture project in Texas, supporting Exxon’s decarbonisation strategy
Management raised its LNG sales target to 50 Mt by 2030, indicating stronger future cash flow prospects
Analysts maintain Hold ratings – no immediate rating upgrade but reinforces current valuation
Share price has rallied ~4% on the news, reflecting short‑term market enthusiasm
No earnings surprise or major M&A; impact is modest but positive over the medium term
